title: 建築環境学Ⅲ
subtitle: Architectural Environment Ⅲ
educationalGoal: Students learn the content and measures of social problems related to the building environment or building equipment. Students learn basic ideas that lead to architecture and community design. *Prediction method of noise propagation and countermeasures. *Sign planning for guiding pedestrians and users. *Relationship between environmental factors and psychology.
advice: 1. Noise prediction method and countermeasures. 2. Sign planning and universal design. 3. Psychological reaction to the environment. 4. Psychological analysis method. 5. Building environment and statistics.
books: Illustrated Text Building Environmental Engineering 2nd Edition (SHOKOKUSYA)
requiredKnowledge: It is a continuous and evolving content of "Architectural environment I,II".Review of the previous knowledge.

Understand the basics of color planning using knowledge of light and color.
